mapper.select: SELECT member_id AS memberId, email, password_hash AS password, name, nickname, member_status AS memberStatus, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, withdrawn_at AS withdrawnAt FROM member WHERE email = #{email} LIMIT 1

SELECT member_id AS memberId, email, password_hash AS password, name, nickname, member_status AS memberStatus, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, withdrawn_at AS withdrawnAt FROM member WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND withdrawn_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
